About Me

I'm a senior at Patrick Henry High School and this is my website! The purpose of this is to showcase pictures, quotes from people I worked with and projects I made. My plan is to pursue biomedical engineering in college. Throughout my time in high school, I have completed two engineering pathways — Computer Science and Engineering Technology. Over the past three years, I've operated industrial machines, led a student club from the ground up, completed a selective environmental summer program, and served as a grant lead for a nonprofit. I love building things: whether that's a robot chassis, games using Python, or a community.

Build Subteam 10th Grade · 2024–25

Safety Lead & Main Lathe Operator

Craft Club — Founder & President

Recognized by San Diego County Assessor Jordan Marks for Outstanding Community Leadership — the club accumulated 444 volunteer hours in its first 9 months. Ruby was personally recognized as founder and 2-year president.

Founder · President
  • Launched the club from scratch — handled officer roles, meetings, supply runs, and deliveries solo in Semester 1.
  • Secured a $500 grant from the PHHS Foundation and free materials from CVS and Hobby Lobby.
